purpose: Test whether prematch state-dynamics histories add stable discrimination between draws and one-goal wins after deterministic matching on existing A01+A02 prematch strength/total environment.

source_boundary.market_reason: A01/A02 contain public match+event data but no PIT-qualified synchronized market quotes; R1 must not fake market matching.

estimand.population: regular-duration matches with both teams having >=4 prior selected A01+A02 matches and final outcome either draw or one-goal win
estimand.target: P(draw | outcome in {draw, one-goal win}, matched prematch environment)
estimand.settlement: 90 minutes including stoppage; only 1H/2H events; non-regular-duration matches excluded

state_features.draw_persistence: mean home/away prior smoothed P(FT draw | tied at 60/70/80)
state_features.equalizer_hazard: mean home/away prior smoothed equalizers per 90 minutes spent trailing by exactly one goal
state_features.rebreak_hazard: mean home/away prior smoothed tie-breaking goals per 90 minutes spent tied after an equalizer
state_features.late_tied_aggression: mean home/away prior smoothed shots per 90 tied minutes from minute 60 onward

evaluation.folds: three growing-train chronological folds; test blocks are non-overlapping by unique-date 40/60/80 percent cutpoints
evaluation.primary_metric: binary log loss candidate minus baseline
development_signal_gate: at least 2 of 3 folds improve log_loss
candidate within-pair accuracy > baseline within-pair accuracy

interpretation.positive_result: development signal only; requires an untouched confirmation design before any scientific/promotion claim
interpretation.negative_result: do not model-shop the same state representation; move to the next orthogonal state/PIT representation or stop
